metadata.title: The affine Tverberg theorem revisited
metadata.abstract: We prove the Bárány--Kalai--Tverberg conjecture extending the affine version of Tverberg's theorem to simplicial balls and polytopes other than the simplex: For any affine map $\phi : P\to \mathbb R^d$ from a convex polytope $P$ of dimension $N=(d+1)(r-1)$ with $r\geq 2$, there exist $r$ pairwise disjoint faces $F_1,\ldots,F_r\subset\partial P$ such that $\phi(F_1)\cap\dots\cap\phi(F_r)\neq\varnothing$. A similar statement holds for a simplicial ball $P$ with $\phi$ assumed affine on all of its faces.

analysis.workSummary: 作者声称证明 Bárány–Kalai–Tverberg 猜想，将 Tverberg 仿射交点结论从单纯形推广到规定维数凸多面体及逐面仿射的单纯球。
analysis.breakthrough: 得到 r 个两两不交的边界面，其像具有公共交点。
analysis.limitations: 凸多面体的整体仿射与单纯球的逐面仿射假设必须保留，不能推广为任意连续映射版本。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 核心离散几何猜想相关，具有广泛潜在影响，优先核查主定理。
